name: Advanced RAG Bot - Hybrid Search, Reranking & Agentic

parameters.functionCode:
const { query, maxSteps, tools, model } = $json.body;

const systemPrompt = `You are an Agentic RAG assistant. You can use tools to find information.

Available Tools:
1. search_dense(query, topK) - Semantic vector search
2. search_sparse(query, topK) - Keyword BM25 search
3. search_hybrid(query, topK, weight) - Combined search
4. fetch_document(docId) - Get full document content
5. search_web(query) - Search the web (if configured)

Current Query: ${query}

Think step by step. Use tools when needed. Format:
Thought: [your reasoning]
Action: [tool_name]
Action Input: [JSON params]
Observation: [result]
... repeat ...
Final Answer: [your answer with citations]`;

return [{ json: {
  systemPrompt,
  query,
  maxSteps: maxSteps || 5,
  tools: tools || ['search_hybrid', 'fetch_document'],
  model: model || 'nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b',
  temperature: 0.1,
  messages: [{ role: 'system', content: systemPrompt }, { role: 'user', content: query }]
} }];

const { collectionName = 'n8n_advanced_rag', vectorSize = 1536, distance = 'Cosine', hnswConfig } = $json.body;

return [{ json: { collectionName, vectorSize, distance, hnswConfig: hnswConfig || { m: 16, efConstruct: 100 } } }];
